mods.description: Toast once when 20 edits and an hour have passed without a commit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: effect-cleanup-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit adds a useEffect that starts an interval, listener or subscription and returns no cleanup
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: empty-test-guard
mods.description: Refuses a test file edit that adds test cases with no assertion in them
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-check
mods.description: /envcheck compares the keys of .env.example with .env and lists the missing and extra ones, never a value
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-drift-band
mods.description: Band with the keys .env.example has and .env lacks, names only, never values
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-dump-guard
mods.description: Blocks dumping the whole environment: bare env, printenv, set and export -p, Get-ChildItem Env:
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-guard
mods.description: Protects .env files from reading and writing (Read, Edit, Write, cat and @mention)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-ignore-status
mods.description: Status line that warns when a .env file is tracked by git or missing from .gitignore
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-keys-pane
mods.description: /envkeys compares the keys of .env.example with .env and lists the missing and the extra ones, never a value
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-names-context
mods.description: Lists the environment variable names the app expects, from .env.example, never their values
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-undeclared-toast
mods.description: A toast when an edit reads process.env or import.meta.env variables that .env.example does not declare
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: error-band
mods.description: Keeps the last failed command and its error line in view until a command passes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: error-context-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit throws an error whose message names nothing, like "failed" or "something went wrong"
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: error-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification when a turn ends on an error or a refusal
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: error-pane
mods.description: /errors opens a pane with every tool call that failed or was denied, its input and the first line of the error
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: esm-guard
mods.description: Refuses require, module.exports and __dirname in .js files of a package that declares "type": "module"
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: explain-mode
mods.description: /explain makes Claude explain each change in one or two sentences, for someone learning the codebase
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: explore-nudge
mods.description: After 15 reads and searches in one turn, a toast and a note to Claude to hand the rest of the exploring to a subagent
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: explore-status
mods.description: Status line with the reads against the edits of the turn, saying whether Claude is still exploring or already changing code
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: expo-install-guard
mods.description: Refuses npm, pnpm or yarn installs of packages the Expo SDK pins and names the npx expo install command, and tells Claude to rebuild the dev client after a native one
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: expo-status
mods.description: Shows the Expo SDK version and the EAS build profiles on the status line of an Expo project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: export-session
mods.description: /save-session writes the conversation so far as Markdown under .claude-exports in the project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: eye-rest
mods.description: The 20-20-20 rule: every 20 minutes of use, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: failed-commands
mods.description: Reminds Claude of the commands that failed earlier in this session, so it does not retry them blindly
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: field-injection-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit adds @Autowired or @Inject on a field instead of the constructor
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-author
mods.description: /who shows who last touched a file or folder, when, and who changed it most
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-churn
mods.description: Toast when the same file is edited six times within half an hour, a sign to step back
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-compare
mods.description: /cmp shows how one project file differs from another, and refuses files that hold secrets
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-diff
mods.description: /fdiff shows what changed in one file since the last commit, without printing secret files
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-mention-hint
mods.description: When a prompt names a file without a path, adds the matching tracked paths so Claude opens the right file first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-trail
mods.description: /trail opens a pane with the files read and changed in the session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: files-band
mods.description: Fixed band with the files Claude changed in this session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: fill-toast
mods.description: A toast when the context window jumps 10 points or more in one step, naming the last tool that ran
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: find-file
mods.description: /ff lists the tracked files whose path contains a text, best matches first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: flatlist-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit renders a mapped list inside a vertical ScrollView, or nests a FlatList in one, in a React Native project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: flood-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a search or command returned over 300 lines, so it narrows the next one instead of repeating it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: focus-band
mods.description: /focus starts a focus block with a pinned progress bar
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: gate-band
mods.description: Band with the tool calls denied and the ones that stopped to ask you in the current turn, and the last one
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: generated-guard
mods.description: Prevents edits in node_modules, dist, build, .next, coverage, .git and the like
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-band
mods.description: Band with the branch, changed files, lines added and removed, ahead/behind and the last commit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-branch
mods.description: /gb lists local branches with the current one marked, or switches to a branch and creates it when missing
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-context
mods.description: Attaches the git state (branch and changed files) to every prompt as hidden context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-fixup
mods.description: /fixup commits the staged changes as a fixup of HEAD or any commit, ready for rebase --autosquash
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-guard
mods.description: Blocks destructive git: push --force, reset --hard, clean -f, --no-verify, branch -D
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-log-limit
mods.description: Adds -n 30 to a git log that has no limit, so the history does not flood the context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-pane
mods.description: /repo opens a pane with the branch, ahead and behind, the changed files and the last 8 commits
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-peek
mods.description: /gs, /gl and /gd: git status, log and diff right away, without spending a model turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-stage
mods.description: /stage lists what is staged, unstaged and new; /stage <paths> stages them and -r unstages, asking first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-stash
mods.description: /gst stashes the working tree with a message, pops the latest stash after asking, or lists the stashes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-status-line
mods.description: Status line with branch, changed files and commits ahead/behind
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-switch
mods.description: /gsw switches branch carrying your uncommitted work: stashes it, switches, and offers it back when you return
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-sync
mods.description: /sync fetches and shows how far the branch is from its base; /sync rebase or merge brings the base in after asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-tag
mods.description: /gtag shows the latest tag and the commits since; /gtag patch, minor or major creates the next version tag after asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-undo
mods.description: /gundo shows the last commit and, once you confirm, undoes it with a soft reset; refuses a pushed commit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: gitignore-guard
mods.description: Asks before a .gitignore edit drops an entry that protects .env, keys or credentials, or git add -f forces one in
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: goal-band
mods.description: /goal pins the project goal above the prompt and in Claude's context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: green-age-status
mods.description: Status line with how long ago the tests last passed and how many edits Claude has made since
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: grep-limit
mods.description: Caps a Grep that prints matching lines at 100 lines and tells Claude when the cap cut the answer
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: group-peek
mods.description: Under a folded run of reads and searches, shows what the live group is on and counts the calls that failed
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hands-band
mods.description: Band that splits the uncommitted files into the ones Claude edited in this session and the ones you changed yourself
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hardcoded-secret-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit puts a hardcoded password, connection string or JWT into source
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hash
mods.description: /hash gives the SHA-256 and SHA-1 of a text in hex and copies the SHA-256
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: head-file
mods.description: /head shows the first numbered lines of a project file, and never prints files that hold secrets
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: heavy-calls
mods.description: /heavy lists the five tool results that took the most context this session, with tool, target and size
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hit-count
mods.description: /hits counts how many times a text appears in each tracked file, most first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hook-order-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit calls a React hook inside a condition, a loop, a callback or after an early return
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: http-probe
mods.description: /http makes a GET request and shows the status, content type, size and first lines of the body
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hydrate
mods.description: Toast every 60 minutes of real use reminding you to drink water
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: idle-clock
mods.description: Status line with how long the session has been idle
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: idle-commit-nudge
mods.description: Shows a toast when the session has been idle for 10 minutes with uncommitted changes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: ignore-check
mods.description: /ignored tells whether git ignores a path and which rule does it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: import-shadow-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit declares a variable, function or class with the same name as one of the file's imports
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: install-ask
mods.description: Requires your confirmation whenever Claude is about to install a new dependency
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: install-status
mods.description: Status line that warns when node_modules is missing or older than the lockfile
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: intent-check
mods.description: /intent says what the session is for; every 30 minutes of use a toast asks if you are still on it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: issue-context
mods.description: When your prompt names an issue (issue #12 or an issue link), its title, labels and text reach Claude as hidden context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: issue-link
mods.description: /closes 12 adds "Closes #12" to the current pull request so the issue closes on merge, after asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: java-print-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit adds System.out or System.err output or a printStackTrace call instead of the logger
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: java-rules
mods.description: In Java projects, keeps Claude on constructor injection, try-with-resources, no swallowed exceptions and the declared Java version
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: jdk-match-toast
mods.description: At session start, toasts when the java on the PATH is older than the JDK that pom.xml or build.gradle declares
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: json-tool
mods.description: /json validates and pretty-prints JSON, and says the line and column of a syntax error
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: jwt
mods.description: /jwt decodes a JWT's header and payload locally, with dates in readable form, and never verifies or sends it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: key-hints
mods.description: Adds to the hint line under the prompt the keys that matter right now: typing, waiting on a turn or idle
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: kill-guard
mods.description: Blocks broad process kills: kill -1, killall, loose pkill, taskkill on system or wildcard names, Stop-Process -Name *
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: kill-port
mods.description: /killport finds the process listening on a port, names it and ends it after you confirm
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: large-write-guard
mods.description: Refuses a Write over 1,500 lines or 200 KB and asks for the file to be split or generated by a script
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: last-cmd-status
mods.description: Status line with how the last shell command ended, passed, failed or interrupted, how long it took and what it was
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: last-error
mods.description: /lasterr recalls the most recent shell command that failed this session and the end of its output
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: last-prompt-band
mods.description: Band with your last request, so you do not lose it after long answers
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: late-night
mods.description: One toast per session when you work after 23:00 local time: it is late, park the work
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: layout-context
mods.description: Gives Claude the folder layout two levels deep, skipping node_modules and build output
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: leftovers-toast
mods.description: Toast at the end of a turn counting the debug logs and TODOs the edits added
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: license-status
mods.description: Status line that warns when the project has no license file or no license field in package.json
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: links-pane
mods.description: /links opens a pane with the URLs that appeared in Claude's answers; press one to copy it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: loc-count
mods.description: /loc counts lines of code by file type for the project or a path, with a total
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: lockfile-guard
mods.description: Prevents hand edits to lockfiles (package-lock, yarn.lock, pnpm-lock, Cargo.lock...)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: log-concat-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit builds a log message by string concatenation or String.format instead of placeholders
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: long-cmd-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification when a shell command that ran two minutes or more finishes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: long-file-toast
mods.description: Toast when an edit takes a file past 500 lines, and again at every 100 more
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: long-turn-toast
mods.description: Toast when a turn runs three times longer than your median and at least two minutes, so you check it is still on track
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: loose-equality-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit compares with == or != where === or !== belongs, leaving == null alone
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: magic-number-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit repeats the same bare number three times instead of naming it once
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: main-branch-guard
mods.description: Refuses commit, push, merge and rebase while the current branch is main/master
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: main-warning-band
mods.description: Red band while you are on main or master
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: map-key-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit maps a list to elements without a key, or uses the array index as the key
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: marker-guard
mods.description: Refuses a commit whose staged changes still hold conflict markers, listing the files
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: memo-prop-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit passes an inline object, array or function to a component wrapped in memo, which defeats the memo
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: merge-ready
mods.description: /ready tells whether the pull request can merge: draft, conflicts, failing checks and missing approvals
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: merged-branches
mods.description: /merged finds local branches already merged upstream and deletes them after asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: metro-guard
mods.description: Asks before expo start or react-native start when a Metro bundler already answers on its port
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: migration-guard
mods.description: Refuses edits to existing database migrations (Prisma, Rails, Django, Alembic, Flyway); a new file is the fix
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: migration-status
mods.description: Status line with the migration files created and not yet committed, ready to apply
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: milestone-toast
mods.description: Shows a toast when the session reaches 10, 25, 50 and 100 prompts
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: minimal-diff
mods.description: Asks for the smallest change that solves the request, with no drive-by refactors; findings are mentioned instead
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: missing-import-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that imports a package which is neither in package.json nor in node_modules
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: mode-keys
mods.description: Adds the key that switches modes to the mode labels in the prompt footer, so you can leave a mode you forgot you were in
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: model-status
mods.description: Status line with the model in use in the session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: model-upgrade-toast
mods.description: A toast when the session switches to a pricier model family, such as Sonnet to Opus
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: mutable-default-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit gives a Python function a mutable default such as [], {} or set()
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: needs-you-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification when Claude stops to ask you a question or needs your permission
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: next-boundary-guard
mods.description: Refuses Next.js app router edits that break the client/server boundary: hooks without 'use client', or server-only code inside a client file
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: no-comments
mods.description: Keeps comments that restate the code, banners and commented-out code out; only the why stays
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: node-version-status
mods.description: Status line entry that shows only when the running Node does not satisfy engines.node, .nvmrc or .node-version
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: open-path
mods.description: /open opens a file or folder of the project in the system's default app; refuses paths outside the project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: oracle-name-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that creates a table, index, constraint, sequence or trigger named over 30 characters, the Oracle 11g limit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: oracle-paging-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that adds FETCH FIRST, OFFSET ROWS or LIMIT to SQL, which Oracle 11g cannot run, and names the ROWNUM form
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: oracle-rules
mods.description: In Oracle projects, makes Claude write SQL that runs on Oracle 11g: ROWNUM, sequences with triggers, bind variables, MERGE
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: oracle-syntax-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that adds IDENTITY columns, LISTAGG ON OVERFLOW, JSON functions or BOOLEAN columns, none of which Oracle 11g has
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: os-context
mods.description: Tells Claude your operating system, shell and installed node, python, java and git versions
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: outdated
mods.description: /outdated shows npm outdated as an aligned table and counts the major version jumps
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: output-lines
mods.description: Heads a long slash command output with the command name and its line count, so you know how far to scroll back
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: param-count-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit adds a function with more than five parameters
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: parking-lot
mods.description: /park <idea> captures an idea without derailing the work and shows it again at the end of the turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: paste-fence
mods.description: Wraps a pasted block of 6+ lines of code or logs in a code fence before it is sent, leaving your sentences outside
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: paste-size-toast
mods.description: A toast when the prompt you send is very large, with its size in lines and tokens, so you can trim a pasted log
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: path-jail
mods.description: Restricts Write/Edit to the project root, the temp folder and ~/.claude (resolves symlinks)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: path-size
mods.description: /size shows how big a file is, in bytes and lines, or a folder, in tracked size and files
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: persistence-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command that makes something run on its own later: cron, schtasks, systemd, launchd or a Startup folder
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: persona
mods.description: /persona changes Claude's voice: mentor, senior, rubberduck, pirata, yoda, zen
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pin-band
mods.description: /pin pins up to 4 project reminders above the prompt
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pipe-shell-guard
mods.description: Blocks curl | sh, wget | bash, iwr | iex and variants
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: plan-first
mods.description: /plan-first makes Claude list the files and the order before editing a change that spans more than two files
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pm-command
mods.description: /pm names the project's package manager and shows its install, add, remove, run and exec commands
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pm-guard
mods.description: Refuses npm, pnpm, yarn or bun commands that use a different package manager than the project's lockfile, and names the right one
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pomodoro
mods.description: /pomodoro [min] with a countdown in the status line, toast and notification at the end
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: ports
mods.description: /ports probes the common dev ports on localhost and lists which ones answer
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: ports-band
mods.description: Band with the dev servers running on localhost
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: posture
mods.description: Toast every 30 minutes of use with one short posture check, rotating through four
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-checks
mods.description: /checks shows the checks of the current pull request and which ones failed, with their links
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-comments
mods.description: /prcomments lists the review comments on your pull request that nobody from your side has answered yet
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-diff
mods.description: /prdiff shows what a pull request changes against its base: files with lines added and removed
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-open
mods.description: /prnew opens a pull request from the current branch with a title and body built from its commits, after asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-review-notify
mods.description: Polls the current branch's pull request every three minutes and notifies once when its review decision changes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-status
mods.description: Status line with the current branch pull request and its review state (via gh)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: pr-style
mods.description: Makes pull request descriptions follow what changed, why, how tested and risks, with a Conventional Commits title
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: priciest-turn
mods.description: /priciest shows the most expensive turn of the session, its share of the total, the prompt and the tools it ran
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: private-host-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit adds a private IP address or an internal hostname to source
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: prod-guard
mods.description: Requires your confirmation for deploys, publishes, terraform apply, kubectl and migrations
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: project-ledger
mods.description: /projspend shows what this project has cost across all its sessions, kept in a ledger per project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: project-status
mods.description: Status line with the project name and version, Node version and package manager
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: prompt-history
mods.description: /prompts opens a pane with the prompts you typed this session; press one to put it back in the prompt box
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: prompt-secret-guard
mods.description: Stops prompts that contain secrets pasted by mistake from being sent
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: prompt-shortcuts
mods.description: Shortcuts ::fix, ::test, ::review, ::explain, ::refactor, ::doc, ::commit become full prompts
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: prompt-stamp
mods.description: Puts the clock time beside each prompt you typed and the sender beside messages from other agents
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: push-reminder
mods.description: Shows a toast when the branch has been three or more commits ahead of its upstream for an hour
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: quality-status
mods.description: Status line with the latest lint, types and build results
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: queue-status
mods.description: Status line with how many prompts you typed that are waiting for the running turn to finish
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: quick-notes
mods.description: /note and /notes: quick notes per project, kept between sessions
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: quiet-window
mods.description: /quiet <minutes> holds every toast and notification for that long, then says once how many were held; /quiet test checks it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: quote-selection
mods.description: /quote quotes in the prompt the passage selected with the mouse
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: rate-limit-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification the first time a rate limit window passes 90%, with when it resets
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: rate-limit-watch
mods.description: Toast when the 5h or 7-day window passes 75/90/95%; /limits lists the usage
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: react-rules
mods.description: In React projects, keeps Claude to the rules of hooks, stable keys, derived state and effects only for synchronization
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: read-cap
mods.description: Reads only the first 600 lines of a file over 150 KB and tells Claude how to continue with offset
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: read-only-status
mods.description: Status line with the files Claude read in this session and never edited, a measure of how much context went to looking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: read-pane
mods.description: /reads opens a pane with the files read this session and how often; files read 3 or more times are flagged as wasted context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: readme-context
mods.description: Gives Claude the first paragraph of the README, so it knows what the project is without reading it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: recent-files
mods.description: /recent lists the files changed most recently, with when, from the last 100 commits
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: red-turn-toast
mods.description: Toast when a turn ends while the last test run is still failing
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: regex-test
mods.description: /re tests a regular expression on a text and lists each match with its position and capture groups
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: registry-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command changes where packages come from: npm, pnpm, yarn and pip registry or index settings
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: release-notes
mods.description: /release creates a GitHub release with notes from the commits since the last tag, after showing them and asking
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: release-status
mods.description: Status line with the package version, the latest tag and the commits waiting for the next release
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: remind
mods.description: /remind <minutes> <text> fires a toast and a notification after that many minutes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: remote-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the default branch and the remote of the repository, so it never guesses main or origin
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: reply-language
mods.description: Makes Claude always answer in the language set in the Cockpit hub, keeping code and commands in the original
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: reply-outline
mods.description: /outline opens a pane with the headings, file references and links of the last reply, to jump to what matters in a long answer
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: reply-size
mods.description: Under a long reply block, shows its word count and how many code blocks it holds, so you can decide whether to read it now
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: reread-guard
mods.description: Refuses reading again a file Claude already read this session when it has not changed, once, with a reason
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: reset-countdown
mods.description: Status line counting down to the reset of the tightest rate limit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: result-fold
mods.description: Folds a shell result of more than 40 lines to its first and last 15 in the transcript; the model still reads all of it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: resume-line
mods.description: On start, one toast with what you were last working on in this project, if it was in the past three days
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: retry-status
mods.description: Status line counting how many times in a row the same command has failed, until it passes or another fails
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: review-queue
mods.description: Status line with how many pull requests wait for your review, and a toast when a new one is requested
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: rm-guard
mods.description: Blocks rm -rf and Remove-Item -Recurse on root, home and drives, plus mkfs, dd and format
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: rn-rules
mods.description: In React Native and Expo projects, keeps Claude on FlatList, StyleSheet, Platform checks and EAS-compatible config
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: run-script
mods.description: /run runs a package.json script with the project's package manager and prints the exit code and last lines
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: runout-projection
mods.description: A toast when a rate-limit window will run out before it resets at the current pace, and /runout lists the projection
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: runtime-band
mods.description: Band that appears when the Node, Python or Java version the project asks for differs from the one installed
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: runtime-pin-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the runtime versions the project pins: .nvmrc, engines, packageManager, .tool-versions
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: scatter-toast
mods.description: Toast when one turn changes eight or more files across four or more unrelated folders
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: script-guard
mods.description: Refuses npm run or pnpm run of a script that package.json does not declare and lists the ones it does
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: script-mode-guard
mods.description: Asks before a script or config gets a world-writable mode, umask 0 or an Everyone grant
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: scripts-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the test, lint, build and dev scripts of package.json and the package manager, so it stops guessing commands
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: scripts-pane
mods.description: /scripts opens a pane with the scripts of package.json; pressing one asks Claude to run it and fix what fails
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: secret-scan
mods.description: Refuses Write/Edit whose content carries API keys, tokens or private keys
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: security-rules
mods.description: Always-on security rules: validate input, parameterized queries, no secrets in code or logs, least privilege, TLS on
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: session-cap
mods.description: Toast after three hours of continuous use in one session, then again every hour
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: session-clock
mods.description: Status line with session time and number of prompts
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: session-diff-band
mods.description: Band with the total lines Claude wrote and removed in the session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: session-stats
mods.description: /stats sums up the session: time, prompts, tools, tokens, context and cost
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: shield-band
mods.description: Band with the count of calls blocked by guards and the last reason
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: slow-call-status
mods.description: Status line with the tool call that has been running longest right now, once it passes 15 seconds
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: slow-toast
mods.description: A toast when a shell command took a minute or more, with the command and how long it ran
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: snapshot-update-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command rewrites test snapshots: jest -u, vitest -u, --snapshot-update, insta accept
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: snippets
mods.description: /snip saves reusable prompt snippets across sessions and puts one in the prompt box by name
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: spend-summary
mods.description: A notification when the session ends with what it spent in total, how long it ran and the cost per turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: spend-today
mods.description: Status line with today's spend summed across all sessions
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: spinner-doing
mods.description: Names the tool call that is running beside the spinner word, so a long wait says what it is waiting on
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: sql-concat-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit builds an SQL statement by joining strings or interpolating values
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: sql-guard
mods.description: Blocks DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE/UPDATE without WHERE in shell commands
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: sql-no-where-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a .sql script edit adds a DELETE or UPDATE with no WHERE clause
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: stack-context
mods.description: Detects the project stack (package.json, pom.xml...) and tells Claude in the system prompt
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: stage-guard
mods.description: Refuses git add -A, git add . and git commit -a while a .env, key or certificate is waiting to be staged
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: staged-status
mods.description: Status line with how many files are staged, unstaged and new, hidden when the tree is clean
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: stand-up
mods.description: Toast after two hours of use without a 10 minute break: stand up and walk
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: standup
mods.description: /standup lists your commits since yesterday morning in this repository, grouped by day and ready to paste
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: stash-pane
mods.description: /stashes opens a pane with the stash list: index, branch, message and how old each one is
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: stash-status
mods.description: Status line that reminds you how many stashes are saved
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: state-mutation-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit changes React state in place (push, splice, sort, property assignment) instead of building a new value
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: step-back
mods.description: Toast after four failed shell commands in a row at the same thing: time to step back and look at the problem
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: style-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the code style your formatter and linter enforce: quotes, semicolons, indent, line width
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: sudo-guard
mods.description: Blocks privilege elevation: sudo, doas, su -c, runas and Start-Process -Verb RunAs
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: suppress-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that adds a blanket suppression: eslint-disable, @ts-ignore, @ts-nocheck, bare # noqa or # type: ignore
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: symbol-def
mods.description: /def finds where a function, class, type or variable is defined in the tracked files
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tailwind-rules
mods.description: In Tailwind projects, keeps Claude on theme tokens, scale steps and mobile-first, without inline styles
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: terminal-pet
mods.description: A mascot above the prompt that reacts: working, happy, sad or sleepy
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: test-first
mods.description: /tdd turns on test-first work: a failing test before the code, run before and after
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: test-pane
mods.description: /testlog opens a pane with every test run of the session: command, pass or fail, duration and time
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: test-setup-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the test framework in use and where the tests live, so new tests go in the right place
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: test-skip-guard
mods.description: Refuses an edit that adds a skipped or focused test: .skip, .only, xit, fit, @Ignore, @Disabled, @pytest.mark.skip
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: test-status
mods.description: Status line entry with the result of the last test run: passed or failed, time and duration
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tests-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification with pass or fail when a test run of 30 seconds or more finishes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: time-context
mods.description: Every prompt carries the current local date, weekday, time and UTC offset so relative dates resolve right
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: timebox
mods.description: /timebox <minutes> <what> counts down on the status line, warns at 80% and notifies at the end
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: timeline
mods.description: /timeline opens a chronological log of the session: prompts, tool calls, failures and turn ends with their clock time
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: timestamp
mods.description: /ts converts epoch seconds, milliseconds, ISO 8601 and local time for now or for any epoch or date
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tldr
mods.description: Adds a 2-sentence TL;DR (via haiku) below long answers
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tls-off-guard
mods.description: Asks before TLS certificate verification is switched off in code or in a command
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: todo-band
mods.description: Project task list pinned above the prompt, clickable and persistent (/todo)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: todo-count-status
mods.description: Status line counting TODO, FIXME and HACK in tracked code
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: todo-new-status
mods.description: Status line counting the TODO, FIXME and HACK lines added to the code in this session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: todo-owner-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit adds a TODO, FIXME or HACK with no owner or ticket
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: token-chart
mods.description: /tokens opens a pane with output tokens per turn as thin gauges scaled to the largest turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tool-clock
mods.description: Appends the duration to every tool row that took a second or more, and tags calls made by a subagent
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tool-tally
mods.description: /tally opens a pane with the call count per tool
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: topic-switch
mods.description: Toast when a prompt shares nothing with the work in progress after several edits, before a second task mixes into the first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: trace-helper
mods.description: Adds a hidden hint to prompts with a stack trace: find the first project frame, read it, state the root cause
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: transactional-private-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit puts @Transactional on a private, static or final method, where Spring's proxy ignores it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tree
mods.description: /tree prints the project's directory tree two levels deep, skipping node_modules, .git, build output and dot folders
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tree-flood-guard
mods.description: Refuses an unfiltered find, ls -R or dir /s that would list node_modules, and suggests git ls-files or Glob
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: try-resources-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit opens a stream, connection or statement in a local variable outside try-with-resources
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: ts-config-context
mods.description: Tells Claude your tsconfig in the system prompt: strict flags, path aliases, module resolution and type-only imports
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tunnel-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command that exposes your machine to the internet: ngrok, cloudflared, ssh -R, tailscale funnel, a dev server on 0.0.0.0
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-files-band
mods.description: Band with the files this turn has read and edited so far, naming the edited ones, cleared when the next turn starts
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-history
mods.description: /turns opens a pane with one row per finished turn: duration, tool calls, output tokens and a cross for failed ones
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-notify
mods.description: Native notification when a turn of 30s or more finishes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-progress
mods.description: Live status line with the elapsed time and tool count of the turn in progress
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-summary
mods.description: Under the duration line that closes a turn, sums it up: tool calls, files changed and failures
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-timer
mods.description: Band above the prompt with duration, tools and tokens of the last turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-toast
mods.description: Shows a toast summarizing every finished turn of 10 seconds or more: duration, tool calls and output tokens
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: turn-tokens-status
mods.description: Live status line with the output tokens of the running turn, growing as the model writes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tw-arbitrary-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit writes an arbitrary Tailwind value like w-[16px] where the scale has the step (w-4)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: tw-conflict-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit puts two Tailwind classes that set the same property on one element, like p-4 and p-2
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: unawaited-promise-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit calls an async function or fetch as a statement and drops the promise
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: uncommitted-band
mods.description: Warning band when changes have gone uncommitted for more than 45 minutes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: untested
mods.description: /untested lists the changed files that have no test file, without spending a model turn
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: untested-turn-toast
mods.description: Toast at the end of a turn that changed code without running a single test
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: unused-import-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit leaves an import that nothing in the file uses
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: upload-guard
mods.description: Asks before a command sends a local file out: curl uploads, wget --post-file, scp or rsync to a host, nc
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: urlcode
mods.description: /url encodes or decodes a string for a URL and copies the result
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: usage-band
mods.description: Fixed band with colored bars for context, the 5h and 7 day windows, and cost
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: uuid
mods.description: /uuid generates up to 20 random UUIDs and copies them to the clipboard
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: vague-name-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit exports a placeholder name such as tmp, foo, stuff or data2
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: verify-claims
mods.description: Claude does not say something works without running it, and ends with what was and was not verified
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: wandering
mods.description: Toast after ten prompts in a row without a single file changed: what would make this done?
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: weak-crypto-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit hashes passwords with MD5 or SHA-1, makes tokens with Math.random, or picks ECB or an unsigned JWT
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: weather-status
mods.description: Status line with the weather in your city (wttr.in)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: weekly-recap
mods.description: On the first session of a new week, one toast with last week's days active, sessions and prompts
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: wip-commit-guard
mods.description: Refuses commits whose message is wip, fix, asdf, a dot or similar, so the history says what changed
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: workspace-context
mods.description: Lists the packages of a monorepo with their folders, so Claude knows where each piece lives
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: wrapper-guard
mods.description: Refuses a global mvn or gradle command when the project ships mvnw or gradlew, so the pinned build tool runs
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: a11y-rules
mods.description: In web projects, keeps Claude to accessibility rules when editing markup: labels, alt text, keyboard, focus, contrast
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: activity-status
mods.description: Live status line with the tool Claude is running right now
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-cap
mods.description: /agentcap <n> caps how many subagents run at once and asks before each one past the cap
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-done-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification when a subagent that ran for 30 seconds or more finishes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-model-note
mods.description: A toast naming the model a subagent resolved to when it differs from the main one, and /agentmodels lists them all
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-pane
mods.description: /crew opens a pane with the session's subagents, their type and status, refreshed while any is running
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-straggler
mods.description: A toast when a subagent has been running more than three times as long as the ones that finished
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-trivial-note
mods.description: A toast when a subagent is spawned for a task one Read, Bash or Grep call would answer
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agent-usage-toast
mods.description: A toast with the tokens a subagent used, and its model, when a run of 10k tokens or more finishes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: agents-band
mods.description: Band showing in real time how many subagents are running and which ones
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: alarms
mods.description: /alarm sets daily alarms at a local time, kept across sessions, with a toast and a notification
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: alias-import-guard
mods.description: Refuses deep ../../ imports when tsconfig paths has an alias for the folder, and names the alias to use
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: amend-guard
mods.description: Asks before git commit --amend or git rebase rewrites commits that are already on a remote branch
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: answer-format
mods.description: /format sets the shape of answers (bullets, steps, table or prose) and shows it in the status line
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: any-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit adds any to TypeScript: ": any", "as any", "<any>" or any[]

mods.name: api-status
mods.description: Status line with the state of the Anthropic API from its public status page
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: archive-add-guard
mods.description: Asks before git add stages an archive, installer or database file, or any file over 5 MB
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: ask-first
mods.description: When a request has two readings that lead to different code, Claude asks one short question first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: base64
mods.description: /b64 encodes and decodes Base64 safely for UTF-8 text and copies the result
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: behind-toast
mods.description: Toast when your branch falls 10, 20, 30 commits behind its base, before the conflicts pile up
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: bg-hint
mods.description: Shows the run-in-background pill under a running tool call in Portuguese or Spanish, keeping your own key binding
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: big-files
mods.description: /big lists the largest tracked files of the project with readable sizes
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: big-output-toast
mods.description: A toast when one tool result is larger than 20,000 characters, since that much output eats the context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: big-read-guard
mods.description: Refuses reading a file over 512 KB whole and asks for a slice
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: branch-drift
mods.description: Toast once when the branch name says one thing and the files being edited say another
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: branch-naming
mods.description: Teaches Claude the branch naming convention: feat/, fix/, chore/, refactor/, docs/ and never new work on main
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: branch-pane
mods.description: /branches opens a pane with the local branches, the current one marked, ahead and behind and the age of the last commit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: break-reminder
mods.description: A toast every 50 minutes of session reminding you to take a break
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: breathe

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: budget-alert

mods.description: Status line with the state of the last GitHub Actions workflow (via gh)

mods.description: Status line with the day and time (useful in fullscreen mode)

mods.name: cmd-log
mods.description: /cmdlog opens a pane with the shell commands, status and duration
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: cockpit

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: code-todo-pane

mods.name: color-tool
mods.description: /color converts a color between hex, rgb and hsl and reports its WCAG contrast on white and black
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: commented-code-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit leaves three or more lines of commented-out code
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Asks you to look at the diff before a big commit goes through, showing the files and lines staged
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: commit-style
mods.description: Makes Claude write short, imperative Conventional Commits
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: commits-today
mods.description: Status line with how many commits you made today in this repository
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: compact-nudge
mods.description: Band with a compact button when context passes 75%
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: concise-mode
mods.description: /concise turns on short, direct answers, with no introduction or recap
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: conflict-band
mods.description: Band that warns about a merge or rebase in progress and files in conflict
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: context-meter
mods.description: Status line with a context bar and cost; warns at 80% and 90%

mods.name: conventions-context
mods.description: Points Claude at CONTRIBUTING.md or a conventions file with its path, size and headings, to read before writing code

mods.description: /copy-last copies the last reply; /copy-code copies the last code block

mods.name: cors-open-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit opens CORS to every origin with * or a bare cors()

mods.name: cost-pane
mods.description: /spend opens a pane with the cost of each turn, the difference of the session cost, and the total

mods.name: cost-per-hour
mods.description: Status line with what the session costs per hour at its pace so far
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: cost-ticker
mods.description: Status line with the cost of the last turn and the session total
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: cost-trend
mods.description: Status line with what the last ten turns cost together and whether the spend is rising or falling
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: coverage-status
mods.description: Status line with the line coverage of the last report in the project, and how far it moved
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: credential-file-guard

mods.name: daily-budget-alert
mods.description: /daybudget <usd> sets a budget for the day across sessions and notifies once when the day's total passes it

mods.name: daily-streak
mods.description: Counts your streak of days using Claude Code; a toast on start and the /streak command

mods.description: /target sets a daily commit goal for this repository; toasts at half and at the goal

mods.name: data-layer-context
mods.description: Tells Claude the database and ORM in use and where the schema and migrations live
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: day-close
mods.description: /dayend sets an hour; at that time one quiet toast sums up the day with prompts, turns and edits

mods.name: day-timer
mods.description: Status line with your active Claude Code time today, summed across sessions

mods.name: db-port-status
mods.description: Status line that warns when the local database or cache the project points to is not listening
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: deadline-band
mods.description: /deadline pins a countdown to the project deadline
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: debug-flag-guard

mods.description: Refuses edits that add a debugger statement, breakpoint(), pdb or binding.pry

mods.description: A toast whenever a tool call is refused, naming the tool and the first line of the reason

mods.name: dep-source-guard
mods.description: Asks before a dependency is pinned to a git URL or tarball, or pulled over plain http
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: deploy-status
mods.description: Status line entry with the result of the last deploy command: vercel, netlify, eas, firebase, fly and others
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: deps-pane
mods.description: /deps opens a pane with npm outdated as a table, major jumps in red and minor ones in amber

mods.name: deps-status
mods.description: Status line with how many npm dependencies are outdated
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit exports a function without the doc comment the file's other exports have
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: docker-band
mods.description: Band that warns when the Docker daemon is down or a compose stack has services stopped
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Asks before destructive Docker commands: system prune, volume rm or prune, rm -f, rmi -f and compose down -v

mods.name: dolar-status
mods.description: Status line with the dollar rate in Brazilian reais (AwesomeAPI)
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: edits-no-commit
mods.description: Toast once when 20 edits and an hour have passed without a commit

mods.name: effect-cleanup-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit adds a useEffect that starts an interval, listener or subscription and returns no cleanup
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: empty-test-guard
mods.description: Refuses a test file edit that adds test cases with no assertion in them
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Status line that warns when a .env file is tracked by git or missing from .gitignore
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: /envkeys compares the keys of .env.example with .env and lists the missing and the extra ones, never a value
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-names-context
mods.description: Lists the environment variable names the app expects, from .env.example, never their values
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: env-undeclared-toast
mods.description: A toast when an edit reads process.env or import.meta.env variables that .env.example does not declare
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: error-band

mods.name: error-context-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit throws an error whose message names nothing, like "failed" or "something went wrong"

mods.name: error-notify
mods.description: Sends a native notification when a turn ends on an error or a refusal

mods.description: /errors opens a pane with every tool call that failed or was denied, its input and the first line of the error
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: esm-guard
mods.description: Refuses require, module.exports and __dirname in .js files of a package that declares "type": "module"
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: explain-mode

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: /save-session writes the conversation so far as Markdown under .claude-exports in the project
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: failed-commands
mods.description: Reminds Claude of the commands that failed earlier in this session, so it does not retry them blindly
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: field-injection-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a Java edit adds @Autowired or @Inject on a field instead of the constructor
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-author
mods.description: /who shows who last touched a file or folder, when, and who changed it most
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-churn
mods.description: Toast when the same file is edited six times within half an hour, a sign to step back
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-compare
mods.description: /cmp shows how one project file differs from another, and refuses files that hold secrets
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-diff
mods.description: /fdiff shows what changed in one file since the last commit, without printing secret files

mods.name: file-mention-hint

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: file-trail

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: files-band
mods.description: Fixed band with the files Claude changed in this session
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: fill-toast
mods.description: A toast when the context window jumps 10 points or more in one step, naming the last tool that ran

mods.name: find-file
mods.description: /ff lists the tracked files whose path contains a text, best matches first

mods.name: flatlist-note

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: flood-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when a search or command returned over 300 lines, so it narrows the next one instead of repeating it
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: focus-band
mods.description: /focus starts a focus block with a pinned progress bar
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: gate-band
mods.description: Band with the tool calls denied and the ones that stopped to ask you in the current turn, and the last one
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: generated-guard
mods.description: Prevents edits in node_modules, dist, build, .next, coverage, .git and the like
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Band with the branch, changed files, lines added and removed, ahead/behind and the last commit
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-branch
mods.description: /gb lists local branches with the current one marked, or switches to a branch and creates it when missing
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.description: Attaches the git state (branch and changed files) to every prompt as hidden context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: git-guard

mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: goal-band
mods.description: /goal pins the project goal above the prompt and in Claude's context
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: green-age-status
mods.description: Status line with how long ago the tests last passed and how many edits Claude has made since

mods.name: grep-limit
mods.description: Caps a Grep that prints matching lines at 100 lines and tells Claude when the cap cut the answer
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: group-peek
mods.description: Under a folded run of reads and searches, shows what the live group is on and counts the calls that failed
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hands-band
mods.description: Band that splits the uncommitted files into the ones Claude edited in this session and the ones you changed yourself
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hardcoded-secret-guard
mods.description: Asks before an edit puts a hardcoded password, connection string or JWT into source
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hash
mods.description: /hash gives the SHA-256 and SHA-1 of a text in hex and copies the SHA-256
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: head-file
mods.description: /head shows the first numbered lines of a project file, and never prints files that hold secrets
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: heavy-calls
mods.description: /heavy lists the five tool results that took the most context this session, with tool, target and size

mods.name: hit-count
mods.description: /hits counts how many times a text appears in each tracked file, most first
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hook-order-note
mods.description: Tells Claude when an edit calls a React hook inside a condition, a loop, a callback or after an early return
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: http-probe
mods.description: /http makes a GET request and shows the status, content type, size and first lines of the body
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: hydrate
mods.description: Toast every 60 minutes of real use reminding you to drink water
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: idle-clock
mods.description: Status line with how long the session has been idle
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: idle-commit-nudge
mods.description: Shows a toast when the session has been idle for 10 minutes with uncommitted changes

mods.name: ignore-check
mods.description: /ignored tells whether git ignores a path and which rule does it

mods.name: import-shadow-note

mods.name: install-ask
mods.description: Requires your confirmation whenever Claude is about to install a new dependency

mods.name: install-status
mods.description: Status line that warns when node_modules is missing or older than the lockfile
mods.author: Matheus Chiodi

mods.name: intent-check
mods.description: /intent says what the session is for; every 30 minutes of use a toast asks if you are still on it

mods.name: last-prompt-band

mods.name: late-night

mods.name: layout-context

mods.name: loc-count

For each routed Agent call it sends the task text, condensed to at most 12,000 characters, the agent's description, cut to 500 characters, and the call's one-line description, all with token-shaped strings such as keys masked, to the provider's own API (api.typesafe.ai, api.openai.com or generativelanguage.googleapis.com), to openrouter.ai or to both, as its provider and gateway options allow, each with its own key. The scope option picks the calls: core routes the four built-in agents, extended also routes user, project and plugin agents and sends their text. Holds the command when the package does not exist (a made-up name), is under 14 days old, or looks like a well-known package and is young or thin (typosquatting). Allow in the band or with /pkg-allow.
mods.author: Lupus Malus Deviant

mods.name: pet
mods.description: A desktop pet and little companion on the Windows desktop, always on top and in front of borderless games: a cardboard box or one of twelve figures (cat, dog, fox, bunny, hamster, owl, penguin, frog, axolotl, dragon, robot, ghost; cat, dog and bunny in nine coats). It says in a speech bubble what Claude is doing and sums up each answer; Claude's questions, Next Steps' suggestions and reply options are buttons in the bubble, and with typing on a hotkey opens a box to answer without leaving the game. A click on the pet shows the last answer in short; an unanswered bubble shrinks to one line. Optionally one pet per active session, each with its own figure and a name tag, asleep while its prompt cache is cold; it warns before the cache goes cold, and its menu keeps the cache warm (1 h, 3 h, always, off). Other mods at the pet: a command Blast Radius holds, a task from Human in the Loop (done or an option with one click) and the CI Watch result come up in the bubble, and stand in short beside its name. Built once with the C# compiler that ships with Windows and signed when a signing script is there. /pet shows it, /pet cat calico picks a figure, /pet stop sends it off.
mods.author: Lupus Malus Deviant

mods.name: read-guard
mods.description: Holds a whole-file Read (no offset/limit) of a file above the limit, a lockfile, minified code or a source map, and the same via cat, type or Get-Content in the shell; tells Claude the size, a token estimate and a better way (Grep, offset/limit). A second try at the same file goes through, and so does a Read with allow_large. Claude Code itself stops only at about 25,000 tokens.
mods.author: Lupus Malus Deviant

mods.name: relay
mods.description: Main agent dispatches tasks to persistent worker sessions via CLI (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode or the Werkbank servers per role); workers report back as compact, lossless-on-essentials relay packets.

mods.name: screen-mask
mods.description: For screen sharing and recordings: hides API keys, tokens, private keys, e-mail addresses, IP addresses, your login name in paths and any names you list. Only the display changes; Claude still reads the original. Nothing leaves the machine. /mask switches it.
mods.author: Lupus Malus Deviant

mods.name: secret-guard
mods.description: Stops before Claude writes API keys, tokens, private keys or a non-ignored .env into files, git add or commits. Exceptions for test keys and example files: /secret-allow.
mods.author: Lupus Malus Deviant

mods.name: sign-guard
mods.description: Spots Windows builds (cargo --release, dotnet publish, go build, pyinstaller, tauri, electron-builder, msbuild) and signs the new .exe/.msi/.msix with your own signing script.

mods.description: Shows who is working now (lane, model, the main loop's prompt size) above the prompt, and a /spick pane with switches (routing, review, gate, guard, lanes, band), lane totals, local quota with each sample's age and recent turns. The switches shape the per-prompt triage checklist, which carries a keyword Hint line per prompt. Enforcement is on facts: the guard lets the main session edit one source file per turn (the second goes to a coder) and sends a turn back once when source was edited and no check passed after the last edit; the gate sends a turn back once when a hinted verdict's role (deep for judgement, the review lane or deep for review) did not complete and no Kept: line says why; both reasons go back in one block. A check that fails twice in a turn adds an escalation line; a coder, planner or deep call with no effort gets the default; a Haiku session past 80k tokens is warned. Each main turn is one JSON line in <config>/spick/turns/<session>.jsonl; /spick spend and /spick audit report on them.

mods.name: clauget
mods.description: The scale, then the diet — and the diet only where the scale says it pays. Each model request inside a turn streams through one hook, whose stop chunk carries the four token counters and the model that answered, so the journal has a line per step, the main loop's and every subagent's apart, and names the cache misses where they happen. /clauget opens the report: the window and the cost, the bill of the prefix by provider with how often each provider's tools were called, the break-even of deferring, the instruction files, and every lever with what it saved and what it cost. Out of the box the mod measures and changes nothing. /clauget on, off or strict turns the levers on from the next session: a policy on the prefix decided once and never moved mid-session, tool results cut to the shape of their fat and filed whole so one Read undoes a cut, a small-prefix explorer agent, a lighter transcript for the compaction, economy tiers that tighten with the plan window, a forecast of when it fills, and prompts deferred to its reset. Each lever was measured on a real session; the ones that lost were closed and are named in the README. Nothing the mod writes reaches the model unless a lever puts it there, and then it is counted in the mod's own column.
mods.author: DevOhMyCode

mods.description: One pane of tabs beside the transcript, and the $.cockpit noun other plugins fill. /cockpit opens it, and so does the Cockpit button in the band above the prompt: Session reads the context window, the turn count, the model and the cost, with a Raster sparkline of the context the session has spent turn by turn; Usage draws what the session cost — the four token counters the API reports, kept apart by whether the main loop or a subagent spent them, the models that answered, the plan windows as bars with what is left of each, and what every plugin's skill listing adds to the system prompt each turn; Stats reads ~/.claude/history.jsonl for the prompts this machine has typed — a contribution calendar, sessions, projects, active days and streaks, counted as prompts and never as tokens; Files lists what Claude read and wrote — file tools and shell commands alike — heaviest first, with the lines each file moved and the letter git gives it now, each row a button that rides the file on the next prompt and says so once it has; Tools tallies every tool call with its time and its failures, MCP tools by their server and their own name rather than the prefix they all share, and lists the last of them; Agents is the session's record of every subagent it started, each under the one that spawned it, with how long it ran and the status it ended on. A plugin adds its own tab in three lines through $.cockpit.tab, and the cockpit owns the pane, the rail, the hotkeys and the focus; hideTabs leaves any of them off the rail, a plugin’s as readily as a built-in one.

mods.name: message
mods.description: What another session sends lands in a tab instead of in the context. A peer's delivery is written to the mailbox under your home directory, listed in the Message tab beside the thread it belongs to, and announced in one line — and the session's transcript does not grow by a byte. The thread draws each message whole, wrapped to the column it has, with a Show more under the long ones that opens the rest in place: reading what was held has to be free, or holding it saved nothing. You read it and decide: Hand to Claude puts it in the context and starts a turn, which is the only moment it costs anything, or the field at the bottom answers it, calling SendMessage in the session's own loop so that no model turn is started to write three words. The left column lists the sessions running on this machine, read from the engine's own register: the name each goes by — the one /rename sets, and the one SendMessage takes — with the folder it works in and whether it is busy, this session named at the head of it and a refresh button (r) for the moment you rename one next door; the footer counts what was sent without a turn, what is held, and the bytes kept out of the transcript, three figures in two units and no total over them. It is the cockpit's fifth tab where a cockpit is seated, and opens a pane of its own where none is. /message opens it, /message hand hands everything held over at once, /message hold turns the holding off for the session, and /message who answers with the register of sessions this one can write to.

mods.name: seek
mods.description: Has Claude look around your code in few, lean steps. Every request re-reads the whole conversation, and whatever Claude reads stays in it for every later request; so your prompt, and the task of a subagent Claude starts, carries your setting to batch the searches and reads Claude can already name, to read definitions or line ranges instead of whole files, and not to read again what the session already holds. mods.name: cockpit
mods.description: Cockpit, one narrow pane. The dispatcher first (12 Nov 2026), the SAME data and words as the local Cockpit page (herd-worker, 127.0.0.1:24365): This laptop (to-dos here urgent first with Run / Mark done; mode, CPU, RAM, temperature, current work), Global (one-line fleet status, the page's « You: what blocks work now » list with one-click answers, errors now, quick actions to send a job or prompt and add a to-do), then Open in Cockpit buttons to the page's modules; a workspace switch per organization; /fleet [module], /dispatch <machine> <text>, /todo <machine> <text>; status line « Fleet: N to do ». Then « Conversations », the Panneau: le Panneau, une seule colonne qui défile, sans onglets, repliable section par section : Fichiers (l'arbre de fichiers de data-goblin intégré, un fichier cliqué est nommé à Claude au prochain message comme le fait filetree), Cette conversation en vue usine (boîte du lead avec modèle · effort ▮▮▯▯, couche des Workflows et agents en arrière-plan repliable par Workflow, une carte par agent : modèle, effort, état, tokens, tok/s, puis « retour au lead · review + merge » et le journal horodaté des 6 derniers événements), Contexte de cette conversation (barre %, tokens, seuil de relais 250 k), Toutes les conversations (une table : qui consomme le plus sur 1 h / aujourd'hui / 7 j, état, tok/s, dernière ligne ; filtres projet, état, Claude/Codex ; top 15 + autres ; Workflows actifs ; barres 5 h, semaine, Codex si coché, tok/s), Graphe des conversations (emplacement réservé). Les autres vues s'ouvrent par leur commande /cockpit, listées en une ligne grise en bas : Cockpit, le seul panneau zoomable (Méga › Projet › Conversation › Agent), en lecture seule, qui regroupe Usine (factory) et Machine, avec un menu vertical à gauche vers les 6 entrées (Jauge, Cockpit, Veille, À toi, Registres, Référence). Onglet Cockpit : bouton « Depuis ton dernier message » (le résumé de la nuit sans tokens : une phrase « Depuis 23:12 (8 h) : 9 PR mergées, 2 CI rouges, 3 conversations t'attendent, 14 $ dépensés », puis par projet ce qui t'attend, la CI rouge, les conversations bloquées ou terminées, les Workflows, les problèmes, À toi, les PR mergées et les $ ; /cockpit depuis [8h|24h|nuit|HH:MM]), boutons Nuit (écran « Bilan avant la nuit » : ce qui tourne et sa fin, heures de nuit inutilisées, quota restant et ce que la nuit consommerait, lanes et paquets prêts ; Nuit active = /veille nuit, Lancer affiche la commande sans rien lancer, Rien), Jour (/veille jour) et Codex (Claude seul par défaut) ; cartes d'une ligne avec un bouton vers le détail (Qui consomme, T'attend, À toi, Claude Control et ses échéances, CI, Quota, Problèmes du jour, En cours : Workflows, agents hors workflow et pipelines avec ETA), puis les sections repliables. Onglets Mission, Focus, Arbre, Pipeline, Workflow (Gantt, Vitesse, agents hors workflow), Journal, Machine, Claude ↔ Codex (qui ouvre, corrige, merge, relais, dépendances, taux de vert) et Galerie (Équipe par rôle avec retour au lead, Carte du contrôle, Codex : approbations et coût). /cockpit [conv|projet|mega|agent|workflow|machine|relais|galerie|nuit|depuis|close] ; /factory et /machine restent des alias quand leur mod n'est pas chargé.
mods.author: Julian Passebecq

En cours (instantané de toutes les conversations en cours), Sélection (cases à cocher par projet), Lot terminé (la Veille compte les conversations terminées depuis le dernier export et propose un bouton « Exporter vers eta »). Erreurs dans ~/.claude/mods-health/export-eta.json (Santé, Problèmes). /export-tout, /export, /export-eta Brief pour une autre IA (/export-eta brief [enfants], boutons du bandeau) : un fichier Markdown masqué sur une conversation et ses sous-conversations (où on en est, ETA, git, PR, messages), copié dans le presse-papiers, sans PR.
